title: Donovian State Media Bulletin
summary: State broadcaster claims Gorgan nationalist militias are massing to attack Zabzimeki civilians.
details: Same B-roll appears across three outlets within 11 minutes. Two clips reused from a 2023 unrelated event. Hashtag #DefendZabzimek trending across Donovian-linked accounts.

title: OSINT Analyst Tip
summary: Reverse image search ties two Zabzimek clips to a Donovian training exercise from 2023.
details: Independent OSINT collective flags account network as previously linked to Donovian influence ops.

title: Gorgan CERT Incident Summary
summary: Border-camera CCTV blackouts and credential-spray attempts against utility SCADA in the same 36-hour window.
details: Spear-phish vector targets a Gorgan logistics contractor; payload calls home to infrastructure previously attributed to a Donovian-linked APT. Website defacement on a Gorgan ministry portal occurs in parallel.

title: EO Imagery — North-of-Border Motor Pool
summary: EO image dated D-3 shows ~40 tracked vehicles, fuel bowsers, and engineering bridging assets at a previously empty motor pool.
details: Cloud cover prevents D-1 EO collection. Single image; cannot establish movement direction or readiness state from imagery alone.

title: SAR Coverage Request
summary: All-weather SAR requested to overcome cloud cover.
details: Synthetic aperture radar provides day-night/all-weather imagery; useful for confirming presence and gross changes despite weather.

title: Emitter Activity — Border Sector North
summary: Intermittent target acquisition radar emissions detected D-4 through D-2. Fire-control radar activity unconfirmed.
details: Terrain masking by the Greater Caucasus ridge likely limits coverage south of the divide; emitter geometry consistent with IADS search role.

title: Thermal Imagery — Infiltration Routes
summary: FLIR overflight detects warm vehicle signatures along two unimproved tracks vicinity Zabzimek at 0220L.
details: Engine exhaust signatures consistent with light-armored vehicles. Gorgan rotary-wing routes through the corridor are within range of suspected IR-guided MANPADS.

title: Space Tasking Notes
summary: LEO EO provides resolution but limited revisit; GEO supports SATCOM/weather. GNSS interference reported near the border.
details: Collection planners must trade resolution vs persistence; counterspace activity to date appears non-kinetic (jamming).

title: Commander Priority Intelligence Requirement
summary: Will Donovia conduct a limited cross-border operation into Gorgas within the next 72 hours?
details: Commander wants BLUF, most likely COA, most dangerous COA, key indicators, and collection gaps.
